mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM ha_workspace_document d LEFT JOIN ha_workspace_file f ON f.owner_key = d.owner_key AND f.agent_key = d.agent_key AND f.scope_key = d.scope_key AND f.path_hash = d.path_hash WHERE f.path_hash IS NULL AND NOT ( d.document_path LIKE 'memory/%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ha_workspace_operation o WHERE o.owner_key = d.owner_key AND o.agent_key = d.agent_key AND o.scope_key = d.scope_key AND o.file_path = d.document_path AND o.operation_type = 'LEGACY_DAILY_IMPORT' ) ) ORDER BY d.owner_key, d.agent_key, d.scope_key, d.document_path LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_workspace_file ( owner_key, agent_key, scope_key, workspace_area, file_kind, write_policy, path_hash, file_path, content_ref, checksum_sha256, size_bytes, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{agentKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{workspaceArea}, #{fileKind}, #{writePolicy}, #{pathHash}, #{filePath}, #{contentRef}, #{checksumSha256}, #{sizeBytes}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO ha_workspace_operation ( owner_key, agent_key, scope_key, path_hash, file_path, operation_id, operation_type, actor_type, session_id, turn_id, tool_call_id, change_json, applied_version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{agentKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{pathHash}, #{filePath}, #{operationId}, 'LEGACY_OPERATION', 'SYSTEM', NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', #{appliedVersion}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO ha_workspace_operation ( owner_key, agent_key, scope_key, path_hash, file_path, operation_id, operation_type, actor_type, session_id, turn_id, tool_call_id, change_json, applied_version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{agentKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{pathHash}, #{filePath}, #{operationId}, #{operationType}, 'SYSTEM', NULL, NULL, NULL, #{changeJson}, #{appliedVersion}, #{createdAt} )
